name: tankdrive-driver
note: Owner report 2026-09-27: a human-driven tank crawls, and leaving it throws the hull into the air and flips it. Walk to tank 2 (Dustbowl, -SpawnIndex 3,5, 17.6 m at yaw ~315), take the driver seat before the bots are released, hold full throttle for 10 s, then leave the seat and watch the hull for 8 s. Grade from the observers' vehicles block: distance covered between drive-0 and drive-3 (the offline tank does ~6-8 m/s), and the hull's height and up-vector across left-0..left-3 (a hull that is thrown reads as a height jump and a tilted up-vector).
